Monsoon Forecasted to Arrive in Delhi Amidst Widespread Rain Alerts

The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has forecast the arrival of the monsoon in Delhi within the next two days, marking the latest onset in five years. This comes as alerts for heavy rain and thunderstorms have been issued for 19 states. Some regions have already seen a significant drop in temperature following recent rainfall.
